native_retrieval.title: Calcutta High Court Orders Arrest of Cricketer Abishek Porel in Rape and Blackmail Case With Private Photos - Republic World
native_retrieval.snippet: * Calcutta High Court Orders Arrest of Cricketer Abishek Porel in Rape and Blackmail Case With Private Photos. ## The Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate arrest of Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel over rape and blackmail allegations. Abishek Porel Arrest Ordered by Calcutta High Court in Rape Case | Image: iplt20.com. In a major legal development, the Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate arrest of Bengal and Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel. The orders come in light of serious allegations leveled by a medical student, who has accused the duo of rape, physical assault, and criminal intimidation. To protect the complainant's privacy and secure critical evidence, the Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate seizure of electronic devices belonging to Porel and the co-accused. While Porel has previously denied the allegations, police confirmed to the court that efforts to locate and arrest the accused are currently underway.

Unity Bank has restructured its IT leadership after completing a merger with G&C Mutual Bank, scrapping its chief information officer role. “Our COO, Akhilesh Mehta has carriage of IT at [executive] level, and we have hired a head of IT and security that reports to the COO,” a spokesperson for the bank said. The bank’s most recent CIO, Fergus Stevens, left in March after just over a year in the role. Unity’s spokesperson told *iTnews* that the bank’s technology priorities remained unchanged under the new IT leadership structure, “namely providing an effective digital banking experience for our members, and robust cyber security for the protection of their funds.”.

native_retrieval.snippet: # Indian police forcibly hospitalize a prominent Cockroach Party activist on hunger strike. Police said activist Sonam Wangchuk was taken to hospital after his health worsened during the hunger strike, and that a brief commotion occurred when some protesters tried to block the move. NEW DELHI — Police forcibly transferred a prominent activist to a hospital in New Delhi on Saturday after his health deteriorated during a 20-day hunger strike tied to India’s viral Cockroach Janta Party movement for education reform. Authorities tightened security around New Delhi’s Jantar Mantar, a designated public protest ground enclosed by police barricades, where activist Sonam Wangchuk has been camped along with students and Cockroach Party activists who demand the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, after allegations that exam papers were leaked in advance. Delhi Police said Wangchuk was taken to hospital after his health worsened during the hunger strike, and that a brief commotion occurred when some protesters tried to block the move.

english_retrieval.title: Spain World Cup Hero Ignites Political Furor With MAGA-Style Hat - HuffPost
english_retrieval.snippet: When politics gets loud, you rely on HuffPost to cut through the noise and get it right. # Spain World Cup Hero Ignites Political Furor With MAGA-Style Hat. Ferran Torres wore a red hat emblazoned with the slogan “Make Spain Great Again” during the team’s celebratory bus parade and party in Madrid. Soccer star Ferran Torres — who scored the extra-time goal that secured Spain’s thrilling World Cup final victory over Argentina on Sunday — wore a red hat emblazoned with the slogan “Make Spain Great Again” during the team’s celebratory bus parade and party in Madrid on Monday. Torres, who plays his club soccer for Barcelona, shared photos on Instagram of himself wearing the cap, which resembled one of President Donald Trump’s “Make America Great Again” hats. Others, however, have argued that the hat was intended to mock the president, noting that Trump had predicted an Argentina victory and has repeatedly attacked Spain’s government in recent years.

english_retrieval.title: How India's youth-led 'Cockroach' movement challenges Modi - DW.com
english_retrieval.snippet: # How India's youth-led 'Cockroach' movement challenges Modi. What started as a satirical protest against exam leaks in India has grown into a wider movement voicing young Indians' anger over jobs and education. Riot police fired tear gas and used batons in New Delhi as tens of thousands of supporters of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) marched towards India's Parliament on Monday (July 20). The CJP began as an online campaign in May and rapidly evolved into a Gen Z street movement, giving a voice to a generation frustrated by unemployment, shrinking opportunities and a failing education system. The youth-led "Cockroach" party is now posing an unexpected challenge for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government, prompting a response that combines political outreach with police action. This is a worthless government," Renuka Chowdhury, an MP from India's opposition Congress party, told DW. The CJP movement gained fresh momentum over the weekend after veteran reform activist Sonam Wangchuk, whose three-week hunger strike has become a symbol of the protests, was forcibly taken to a hospital by police.
